title: Ops breadcrumbs: scratch log and runbook TODOs
content:
Ops breadcrumbs — Julian Rivera — night shift notes
Date: 2026-06-07 (shift 22:00-06:00)

Quick context
- Two noisy pages in window 23:10–01:00, both resolved but left follow-ups.
- Cluster autoscaler flapped briefly; some pods evicted causing increased 5xx on /generate for ~6m.
- Hit a throttle pattern from a downstream partner (internal quota spike).

Pages (timeline)
- 23:07 ALERT: high 5xx rate (prod-us-west) — pager.
  - Root symptom: RPS stable but p50 p99 latency up -> backend returned 503 for inference worker.
  - Immediate: ramp route to fallback-model group (policy: fast-failover) — did that at 23:12.
  - Command used: kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-worker-v2
  - Logs: /var/log/inference/worker.log (grep TIMESTAMP 2026-06-07T23:00..23:20) -> OOMKill on one node + kubelet evict.
  - Temporary mitigation: scaled inference-worker-v2 + cordoned node ip-10-2-7-88.

- 00:42 ALERT: increased 429s from partner-api (service: partner-proxy)
  - Observed burst of retries causing upstream throttles. Partner support notified (DM to #partner-oncall).
  - Action: activated partner bypass route and enabled client-side token-bucket (limit=150rps) at 00:46.

Incident follow-ups (TODOs)
1) Investigate OOM pattern on ip-10-2-7-88 (ticket INF-4821).
   - Dumped dmesg + kube events. Suspect gc+large-batch interplay.
   - TODO: add memory headroom alert to autoscaler (threshold adjust from 75% -> 70%). Owner: Samir. Due: 2026-06-10.
   - TODO: reproduce in staging with heavy-batch test (input sizes 4k tokens, concurrency 40). Owner: Julian. Due: 2026-06-09.

2) Partner throttle policy review.
   - Add explicit circuit-breaker in partner-proxy with rollup backoff. Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-06-11.

3) Runbook gaps (notes for playbook update).
   - Current runbook says: "scale down fallback-model if errors persist" but lacks guidance on cordoning vs draining.
   - Add step: "If OOM suspected, cordon + create replacement node, wait 2m, then drain if repeated OOMs". Owner: Julian. Due: 2026-06-12.
   - Add commands snippet and log grep examples to runbook.

Quick command snippets (for runbook insertion)
- Check recent OOMs: journalctl -k | grep -i oom -n --after-context=2 | tail -n 40
- Pod evictions: kubectl get events --field-selector reason=Evicted -n inference --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 20
- Find memory-hungry processes on node: ssh node && sudo ps aux --sort=-rss | head -n 25

Metrics & observations to attach to postmortem
- 5xx spike window: 2026-06-07T23:07:00 -> 2026-06-07T23:14:00 (6.8 minutes). Peak 5xx rate = 82 rps (baseline 4 rps).
- Node memory utilization at 23:05: 93% on ip-10-2-7-88.
- Autoscaler decision log: scaled up 3 replicas at 23:09, but one new pod scheduled to same overloaded node due to scheduling binpacking.
- Suggestion: add podAntiAffinity soft rule for inference-worker to spread across nodes.

Notes to self (short and choppy)
- check scheduler constraints: affinity/anti-affinity not applied? maybe tolerations?
- reproduce with stress-ng + kube-bench style load generator (create synthetic requests with large context).
- follow up with infra-team triage sync next Wed.

Communication/outreach
- Sent Slack note to #sre-ops summarizing mitigation and follow-ups (link pinned).
- DM to partner oncall: confirm throttle knobs and plan for gradual ramp tomorrow morning.

Open quick fixes I did during shift (for tickets)
- Added temporary autoscaler mem buffer (config map update) -> rolled out to prod-canary.
- Applied cordon to ip-10-2-7-88 and used kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data to move pods.
- Created INF-4821 and assigned to Samir.

Runbook TODO checklist (to author before handing off)
- [ ] Paste command snippets above into playbook
- [ ] Write decision tree for cordon vs drain vs scale
- [ ] Add example Grafana query for "node memory by instance" and alert thresholds
- [ ] Update runbook with partner-throttle play (include token-bucket param example)

Post-shift handover summary (to include in handoff doc)
- Short: OOM on node caused brief 5xx spike; mitigated by scaling + cordon; partner caused 429s separately and was addressed by bypass route.
- Key owners: Samir (investigation INF-4821), Maya (partner throttle config), Julian (runbook updates + reproduce test).

Misc scribbles (for later cleanup)
- Maybe add a feature: "preferential scheduling for cache-warmed pods" — reduce cold-start OOM risk.
- Check GH PR #678 for autoscaler config diffs before merging to main.

End of shift notes.

[hand-off to morning shift: add to handoff sheet link and flag INF-4821 as high priority for Monday morning sync]
